[b]THE SPACE PROGRAMME[/b]
Hydronia is developing its economy rapidly and has recently reached a GDP of 3 trillion Hydronic Dollars. Upon reaching this milestone, the government has announced its plans to set up a space exploration program.  Several private Hydronian companies have created specifications for spacecraft, but have not been able to receive the appropriate government funding to develop these spacecraft until now. One of the most notable Hydronian satellite designs is the OWLS-2. OWLS stands for Orbital Wide-Laser Scanner. This satellite uses harmless lasers to measure the altitude of parts of erenes surface. This can then be transmitted back to a lab and inputted into geographical information systems. Hydronia has reached out to Thýven to begin a joint THEP space program. This could happen after the recently speculated unified currency is created. This would allow for more effective trade and cooperation and therefore more effective spacecraft can be constructed.

[nation]The Crystalline Empire[/nation]
